description: Discovered in AS-7 first-fire ops verification (2026-08-30): the watcher fired correctly for messageId 120, but the spawned tick died in ~2s with 'Not logged in - Please run /login'. Diagnosis (orchestrator-verified via env -i tests): claude auth on this host is macOS-Keychain-based and requires USER in the process environment; the watcher's child env is exactly {PATH, HOME} per the AS-7 plan's minimal-env rule — one variable too strict. 'env -i HOME=... USER=... PATH=... claude -p' works; without USER it reproduces the failure. THE FIX: apps/chat/watch/advance-watcher.mjs, fire(), child env construction (currently 'env: { PATH: process.env.PATH, HOME: process.env.HOME }', line ~371) — add USER, and consider LOGNAME for the same keychain/identity reason. Do NOT widen further: the minimal-env principle stands, and each added variable needs a stated reason. Also update the comment above the spawn call to record why USER is present. Tests: apps/chat/test/watcher.test.js does not currently assert child env contents (verified by grep), but Priya's AS-7 review verified 'child env exactly {PATH, HOME}' from source — that pin is now stale and must be understood as {PATH, HOME, USER(, LOGNAME)}; if any assertion pinning the env exists or is added, it pins the new set. Priority high: this blocks the chat app as the board's primary interface — every message-triggered tick dies at auth until fixed.
title: advance-watcher: pass USER (keychain auth) in tick child env
